name: toolfit-finance
description: Finance stack: an accounts receivable and collections desk where every figure is computed by a bundled script.

interface.shortDescription: AR and collections, with the maths done by a script
interface.longDescription: Turns a QuickBooks, Xero or CSV invoice ledger into aged receivables that cross foot, DSO with a reliability check, a ranked call sheet and chase briefs. Every figure is computed by a bundled Python script rather than by the model.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use my Toolfit Finance skills to work through my receivables.
